protocol.protocol: Paired equal-evaluation-budget BO vs SciPy DE; shared initial observations
protocol.timing: Same measured initial evaluation time charged to both methods; warm-up and holdout excluded from search time. Includes CPU proposals, transfers, resets, scoring and physics.
protocol.selection: Lowest feasible TRAINING score per run and per method. Holdout/Gazebo only accept or reject finalists; their scores do not select gains.
protocol.order: Alternating BO-first and DE-first across seeds; one GPU worker, sequential methods.
protocol.scope: 5-seed nominal simulation experiment; not proof of global or hardware superiority.

counts.excludes: Warm-up, active-reference, padded worlds, heldout and Gazebo checks
